ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure there is a black rowing route going around five numbered buoys. Buoy 3 is at the upper left, buoy 1 is above and to the right, buoy 4 is on the right side, buoy 5 is at the lower right, and buoy 2 is below and to the left. The upper straight arrow on the route points to the right, and the route arrow near the boat at the lower left points to the left, indicating that this lower segment is moving toward the boat. Reasoning: Trace along the route according to the arrow directions; the upper route goes from left to right, and the lower part near the boat goes from right to left. Looking one by one at the local direction in which the route goes around each buoy: when going around buoy 1, the route's turning direction is counterclockwise; when going around buoy 3, the route's turning direction is also counterclockwise. The local turning direction around buoys 2, 4, and 5 is not counterclockwise. Therefore the buoys Eva went around counterclockwise are 1 and 3.

method.method_draft: Trace Eva's route in the direction shown by the arrows on the drawn path: the upper straight part is travelled to the right and the lower part near the boat is travelled to the left. For each numbered buoy, look at the local loop of the route around it and decide whether Eva goes around that buoy counter-clockwise or clockwise. The loops around buoys 1 and 3 are traversed anti-clockwise; the others are not.

推理：按箭头方向沿路线追踪，上方路线从左向右走，下方靠近小船处从右向左走。逐个看路线绕每个浮标的局部方向：绕浮标1时，路线的转向是逆时针；绕浮标3时，路线的转向也是逆时针。绕浮标2、4、5的局部转向不是逆时针。因此 Eva 逆时针绕过的浮标是1和3。

method.method_draft: Treat each buoy number as a point and use a signed winding/angle-change test. Applying this to the five labelled buoys gives positive anti-clockwise winding for buoys 1 and 3 only.
